title: Nimble Smoked Galician Potatoes Patatas Bravas
description: Umami, shattering, solo-dinner Spanish dish from Galicia region. Featuring dried oregano, namul-blanch-season, gluten-free-friendly. Form: Patatas Bravas, Vessel: Tandoor Clay Pot.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 1807C (356F).
Peel the potatoes and cut into 1.5 cm (0.6 in) wedges.
Soak the potato wedges in cold water for at least 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry with paper towels.
Toss the potatoes with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, smoked paprika, dried oregano, and namul-blanch-season in a bowl until evenly coated.
Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil in the tandoor clay pot over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shallots and cook for 2 minutes, until translucent.
Add the red chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the potatoes and cook for 20 minutes, until they start to brown, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the potatoes to a plate and top with the cooking oil from the pot, smoked paprika, and dried oregano.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Serve with a side of alioli or a dollop of sour cream, if desired.
